name: Puppet
oneLiner: paper collage on twos: the brand's own faceless character hangs from a drawn hand's marionette strings over a mustard sun and grey scanned rocks, until the founder's real head bursts out and the strings drop
bestFor: founder-led brands, personal brands and coaches, anything about taking back control; vertical reels and story ads with a one-line punchline
motion: everything on twos (steps at 12 fps): rise, drop, a jerk every 0.5 s answered by a lagged dangle, strings re-aimed every frame, a burst, a let-go, words slapped in one by one

sound.ui: pop on each piece landing, a dry tick on every jerk of the strings, one hit on the founder's head bursting out, whoosh as the hand lets go, a pop per headline word, shimmer on the URL
